title: Rice Age device scan submission
description: PROVISIONAL v1.0 contract for the structured JSON a Rice Age IoT analyser submits with POST /api/v1/device/scans. Derived from Rice_Age_SOR_V5 sections 5.3-5.4 and the APSCSCL Sample-0038 report. Fields marked PROVISIONAL depend on decisions DR-001..DR-004 and DR-007 and may change after firmware-team confirmation. Department ownership is never accepted from this payload; the server resolves it from the authenticated device's active assignment.

schema_version.description: Payload contract version. The server rejects unsupported major versions. Current: 1.0.

client_scan_id.description: Stable, device-generated identifier for this analysis. Combined with the authenticated device it is the idempotency key: replaying the same value with an identical payload is safe, with a different payload it returns HTTP 409.

device_id.description: OPTIONAL. Logical device identifier. If present it must equal the device authenticated by the bearer token; a mismatch is rejected with 403. It never selects the department.

sample_id.description: Sample identifier printed on the device report, e.g. "Sample-0038".

batch_id.description: OPTIONAL. Batch code as supplied by the device, e.g. "BATCH-2026-001". Resolved or created within the device's department only.

variety.description: OPTIONAL. Commodity/variety label as printed, e.g. "Raw Rice".

analyzed_at.description: Device-reported analysis completion time in RFC 3339 with offset. Server records receipt time separately; a device clock far in the future is rejected.

analysis.description: Grain and quality measurements. `measurements` is the extensible carrier; the flat grain fields below are accepted for convenience and normalised server-side.

grain_count.description: OPTIONAL. Total kernels counted. Normalised to measurements[code=grain_count, basis=count].

avg_length_mm.description: OPTIONAL. Mean grain length in millimetres. Normalised to measurements[code=avg_length_mm, basis=dimension].

avg_breadth_mm.description: OPTIONAL. Mean grain breadth in millimetres. Normalised to measurements[code=avg_breadth_mm, basis=dimension].

length_breadth_ratio.description: OPTIONAL. L/B ratio. Normalised to measurements[code=length_breadth_ratio, basis=ratio].

grain_shape.description: OPTIONAL. Shape classification as supplied, e.g. "Short Bold". Stored as metadata, not interpreted.

measurements.description: Named measurements. Each value carries its own unit and basis so count-based and mass-based results for the same metric remain distinct.

code.description: Stable metric code, e.g. head_rice, big_broken, small_broken, total_broken, foreign_matter, damaged_grains, discoloured_grains, chalky_grains, dehusked_grains. New codes are accepted without a schema change.

label.description: OPTIONAL. Device display name, e.g. "Big Broken Grains (25% - 75%)".

value.description: Measured or estimated value. Must be non-negative; percentages are 0-100.

basis.description: Measurement basis. The portal never converts between bases and never combines them in one aggregate. `estimated_mass_percent` is an optical estimate and must not be presented as a physical measurement.

is_estimated.description: OPTIONAL. Defaults to true for mass percentages and false for count/physical bases. Required to be true when basis is estimated_mass_percent.

basis_note.description: OPTIONAL. Required when basis is `other`: a short description of the supplied basis.

rice_age.description: PROVISIONAL. Device-supplied rice-age output. May be null or omitted; the portal must render "Not available" and must never infer or zero-fill an age. The final shape, units and confidence semantics are pending DR-001..DR-003.

age_value_months.description: OPTIONAL. Scalar age in months, when the device supplies a point estimate.

age_min_months.description: OPTIONAL. Lower bound of a supplied range, e.g. 8 for "8-10 Months".

age_max_months.description: OPTIONAL. Upper bound of a supplied range, e.g. 10.

age_category.description: OPTIONAL. Category or label exactly as supplied, e.g. "8-10 Months" or "Above 1 Year".

proportion_percent.description: OPTIONAL. Share of the sample in this age bucket; the Sample-0038 certificate reports 100%.

unit.description: OPTIONAL. Declared unit, e.g. "months". Stored verbatim.

model_version.description: OPTIONAL. Algorithm/model version. Required before age results are compared across scans.

confidence.description: OPTIONAL. Only when the device defines its semantics; the portal does not invent one.

validation_status.description: OPTIONAL. Validation provenance supplied by the device or pipeline.

raw_value.description: OPTIONAL. Verbatim device text, e.g. "8-10 Months (100%)", retained for traceability.

evaluation.description: Source evaluation as produced by the device. The portal stores and displays these values; it does not recompute verdicts (SOR section 8).

overall.description: Device's overall quality verdict, independent of processing state.

ruleset_version.description: Ruleset identifier, e.g. "demo-v1". Not a claim of statutory validity.

certification_status.description: e.g. "advisory_only". Display-only; the portal never asserts certification.

parameters.description: OPTIONAL per-parameter evaluations, including the stated limit.

basis.description: Basis this verdict was evaluated against.

comparison_operator.description: Operator as supplied, not inferred from the limit text.

attachments.description: Manifest of files the device intends to upload. Bytes are uploaded separately through the prepared-upload flow; this array declares roles and metadata only. Whether report_pdf and both images are mandatory is pending DR-007.

role.description: report_pdf = original analysis PDF; bottom_image = primary platen capture; top_image = verification platen capture.

content_type.description: Declared media type. The server validates magic bytes before accepting the file. The final allowlist is pending DR-006.

filename.description: OPTIONAL display filename. Never used to build a storage key.

size_bytes.description: OPTIONAL at manifest time; required at prepare. Upper limits are configurable and pending DR-005.

sha256.description: OPTIONAL here, required when preparing the upload so the server can verify integrity on finalize.

note.description: OPTIONAL. Required for role "other" to explain the attachment.

metadata.description: OPTIONAL free-form device metadata (firmware context, station identifiers). Stored as-is and never used for authorization.
